title: Rays vs Brewers: Baseball Gets a Brand-New Champion
audience: Baseball fans and casual sports viewers
whyCare: Neither the Rays (lost 2008, 2020) nor the Brewers (lost 1982) has ever won the World Series, so a first-time champion is guaranteed. Series runs Oct 23-31.

evidence.claim: 2026 World Series: AL champion Tampa Bay Rays vs NL champion Milwaukee Brewers, from Oct 23, possible Game 7 Oct 31 (Wikipedia, revised 2026-10-20)
MLB.com: Brewers' only previous World Series was 1982; Rays reached it in 2008 and 2020 and have never won

angle: Compare table Rays vs Brewers (founded, previous WS trips, years waiting); timeline of near-misses (1982, 2008, 2020); closing stat on the last first-time champion (verify before production). Team colours and a trophy icon - no player likenesses needed.
